description: Designs the inbound GraphQL adapter of an already-modeled use case — schema-first, Spring for GraphQL on the servlet stack — into the `31-graphql.md` partial: the root fields and the input port each calls (the same port a REST adapter calls), types and nullability, mutation inputs and payloads with `userErrors`, Relay connections with a page ceiling, `@BatchMapping` child fields and the batch ports they ask for, the error map, field-level access, personal data per output field, and — on the project's first GraphQL case — the depth, complexity, timeout, batch-size, introspection, GraphiQL and CORS setup, plus a quota per caller or a concurrency cap when the use case states one. Use when the request involves GraphQL, a schema or `.graphqls` file, a query or mutation, a resolver, `@QueryMapping`, `@BatchMapping`, DataLoader, N+1 in GraphQL, a connection or cursor, GraphQL errors, or a rate limit on the GraphQL endpoint. Piece of the `/new-feature` pipeline: requires `10-domain.md` and a `00-use-case.md` whose `Trigger` names a GraphQL adapter in the given folder — and stops without them.
